name: Gust of Wind

duration.text: until the start of your next turn

outcomes.success: The creature can't move against the wind.
outcomes.failure: The creature is knocked prone. If it was flying, it suffers the effects of critical failure instead.
outcomes.criticalFailure: The creature is pushed 30 feet in the wind's direction, knocked prone, and takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage.

entries: A violent wind issues forth from your palm, blowing from the point where you are when you cast the spell to the line's opposite end. The wind extinguishes small non-magical fires, disperses fog and mist, blows objects of light Bulk or less around, and pushes larger objects. Large or smaller creatures in the area must attempt a Fortitude save. Large or smaller creatures that later move into the gust must attempt the save on entering.
